ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line segments $AB$ and $CD$ are on the same straight line, where $M$ and $N$ are the midpoints of $AB$ and $CD$, respectively. Given that $AB = 6\,\text{cm}$ and $CD = 8\,\text{cm}$. When point $C$ is on line segment $AB$, if the common part $BC$ of the line segments $AB$ and $CD$ is $2\,\text{cm}$, then what is the length of $MN$ in cm?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since M and N are the midpoints of the line segments AB and CD, respectively, and AB=6cm, CD=8cm,\\
therefore, AM=3cm, DN=4cm.\\
Since the common part of the line segments AB and CD is BC=2cm,\\
therefore, the length of AD is AB+CD−BC=6+8−2=12cm,\\
therefore, the length of MN is AD−AM−DN=12−3−4=\boxed{5cm};
